title: Dad's Airport Time Deficit
style: anxious jazz fusion comedy, 128 BPM, frantic walking bass, brushed snare, tenor saxophone, vibraphone, male storyteller vocal, deadpan family duet, airport ambient SFX, theatrical paranoia, hooky chorus
lyrics:
[Intro — airport ambient, distant boarding announcement, frantic walking bass]
The flight is at six thirty
We're leaving the house at noon

[Verse 1]
Dad checked the weather, dad checked the route
Dad checked the GPS, dad checked the suit
Dad printed the boarding pass three months ahead
Laminated copy taped above the bed

[Pre-Chorus]
What if there's traffic?
What if there's flooding?
What if the airport relocates without telling us?
What if a bridge goes out?

[Chorus]
Dad's airport time deficit!
Six hours early for a forty-five minute domestic flight
Dad's airport time deficit!
We've already eaten lunch and the gate isn't open in sight!
Dad's airport time deficit!

[Verse 2]
Mum brought a book, the kids brought their phones
Dad has the passports in three different zones
Front pocket, back pocket, neck pouch underneath
Dad has security clearance like a state chief

[Pre-Chorus]
What if the queue is huge?
What if they pull us aside?
What if I forgot to declare a banana?
What if I get banned for life?

[Chorus]
Dad's airport time deficit!
Six hours early for a forty-five minute domestic flight
Dad's airport time deficit!
We've already eaten lunch and the gate isn't open in sight!
Dad's airport time deficit!

[Bridge — spoken, frantic]
[mum] Dear. The flight has been delayed.
[dad] Delayed? By how long?
[mum] Two hours.
[dad] So we're now eight hours early.
[mum] Yes.
[dad] …I'll go check the gate again.

[Outro]
Dad's airport time deficit!
He's living in tomorrow already!
Dad's airport time deficit!
